vya_text: gU0 - atha AsavAriShTAdhyAyamAha | yaddravyam auShadhAdidravyeShu pAnIyAdiShu cirakAlasthaM sandhitaM tat ucitaM BeShajaM AsavAriShTaBedaiH procyate | ucitaM svarogocitam || 1 ||

yadapakvauShadhAmbuByAM siddhaM madyaM sa AsavaH |

vya_text: gU0 - tatrApi AsavAriShTayorBedamAha -- yat apakvauShadhAmbuByAM siddhaM madyaM sa AsavaH tadguNAH - `CedI madhvAsavastIkShNA' iti procyate | apakvauShadham ambu ca vahnipAkarahitaM | yastu kvAthasiddhaH sa ariShTaH syAt | vahniyogAdBUyAnBedaH | tayorAsavAriShTayormAnaM BakShaNapramANaM, tadguNAstu ``yathA dravyaguNo~ariShTaH sarvamadyaguNAdhikaH'' || 2 ||

dI0 - idAnIM tasya viSeShalakShaNAnyAha - yaditi | tayorAsavAriShTayormAnaM pAnArthaM tulanArUpaM jalonmitamiti | jalapAnamAtraM jalapAnaM tu alpameva kathitaM naitanmanoharam, kuto madAtyayaviShayatvAt | nIrujAnAM tantrAntarIyamAnaM yat tajjalaSabdena kalpyate | tadyathA - ``SuddhakAyaH pibet prAtaH sopadaMSaM paladvayam | madhyAhne dviguNaM tacca snigdhAhAreNa pAyayet'' ityAdi vacanAt | eke tripalonmitamiti paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca || 2 ||

atha surAprasannAdInAM madyaBedAnAM lakShaNamAha -
paripakvAnnasaMdhAnasamutpannAM surAM jaguH |
surAmaNDaH prasannA syAttataH kAdambarI GanaH || 5 || 
tadadho jagalo j~jeyo medako jagalAddhanaH |
vakvaso hRutasAraH syAtsurAbIjaM ca kiNvakam ||6||

vya_text: gU0 - atha surA | paripakvasya pAcitAnnasya yatsadhAnaM tasmAtsamutpannAM surAM jaguH | atha prasannAM kAdambarIM cAha -uktAyAH surAyAH maNDaH PenaH prasannA syAt tataH GanA dRuDhA kAdambarI syAt | atha jagalaM medakaM cAha - tadadhaH surAyA adhaH yo dravaBAgaH sa jagalastasmAt yaScyavaH medakaH | atha surAbIjaM kiNvakamAha - sa medakaH hRutasAraH surAbIjaM Bavati ca punaH kiNvakaM Bavati bIjamutpattisthAnaM vivakalahastIti BAShAyAm || 5 || 6 ||

dI0 - idAnIM surAviSeShaNalakShaNamAha - paripakvAnneti | yat SAlyAdikaM sampAcya punaH sandhitaM Bavati tena yat samutpannaM tAM surAM jaguH | eShA paiShTI surA loke `vaganI' SabdavAcyA viKyAtA | athAnye bahavo BedAstAnAha -surAmaNDa ityAdi | yaH surAmaNDaH uparyacCo BAgaH sA prasannA kathitA, yo GanaH sa eva kAdambarISabdena vAcya: | Ganastu surABAga eva, yaH surAyA adhasthito Bavati sa jagalo j~jeyaH | yo jagalAt ki~jcidGanaH sa medakasurAsaMj~jaH kAdambaryA BinnaH ki~jciddhanatvAt | yo hRutasAraH sa `vakkasa'saMj~jaH | surAbIjaM tu kiNvakamiti | SAlipiShTapraBavaM kiNvakamiti kathitam | ete surABedA darSitAH | te ca lokato j~jAtavyAH || 5 || 6 ||

yattAlaKarjUrarasaiH saMdhitA sA hi vAruNI |

atha SuktamAha -
kandamUlaPalAdIni sasnehalavaNAni ca || 7 || 
yatra drave~aBiShUyante tacCuktamaBidhIyate |
vinaShTamamlatAM yAtaM madyaM vA madhuradravam || 8 || 
vinaShTaH saMdhito yastu taccukramaBidhIyate |
guDAmbunA satailena kandamUlaPalaistathA || 9 || 
saMdhitaM cAmlatAM yAtaM guDaSuktaM taducyate |

vya_text: gU0 – SuktaguNAH - `raktapittakaPotkledi SuktaM vAtAnulomanam ? aBiShUyante kShipyante, spaShTamanyat | cukramAhuH cukraM madyaBedaH, atha guDaSuktam evamevekShuSuktam iti madyaBedaH || 7-9||

dI0 - adhunA SuktAdilakShaNaM darSayannAha - kandamUleti | etacca sAmAnyalakShaNamaBihitam, kandamUlaPalAdIni iti | kandAni sUraNapraBRutIni, mUlAni mUlakapraBRutIni, PalAni karamardakaraMBAPalapraBRutIni, AdiSabdAt patrapuShpanAlAdayo gRuhyante | na kevalaM lavaNatailaM, cakArAdrAjikAharidrAdInAmapi grahaNaM, vyavahAratastu lavaNatyAgenApi pracarati | yatra drave pAnIyapraBRutike etAni vastUni sUyante sandhAnIBUtAni kriyante tat SuktamaBidhIyate iti | nanu `SuktaM cukramucyate' iti vadanti tatkathamasya SuktasaMj~jA kathyate ? satyam | Suktavat sandhitAnAM kandAdInAmapi cukrasaMj~jAtrApyaBihitA na tu sAkShAt SuktaM coktam | atha atrApi madyalakShaNamAha etadapi SuktaBedamAhuH | taduktaM guNAvalyAM ``gauDAni rasaSuktAni madyaSuktAni yAni ca | yathApUrvaM gurutarA- NyaBiShyandakarANi ca'' iti | vinaShTamamlatAM yAtaM madyamiti taducyate | sarvaM madyaM pa~jcarasaM kAlAntaravaSAd yadA saMtyajya paramamlatvaM yAti SuktaM taducyate iti | madhuradravamiti | guDekShurasamadhupraBRutikam | tathAhi - `yanmadhvAdau Sucau BANDe saguDakShaudrakA~jjikam | dhAnyarASau trirAtrasthaM SuktaM cukraM taducyate' iti | vinaShTa iti vigatarasaH | sandhitaH sandhAnIBUtaH | idAnIM guDAdiSuktalakShaNamAha - guDeti | guDaSuktamiti guDapradhAnaM SuktamityarthaH | SeShaM sugamam || 7-9 ||

pada:

evamevekShuSuktaM syAnmRudvIkAsaMBavaM tathA ||10||

vya_text: dI0 - evameveti | guDaSuktavadikShurasaSuktaM sandheyam | ikShuSuktamitIkShurasAdikRutaM, mRudvIkA drAkShA tatsamBavaM Suktam | etadapi pUrvavat sandheyam | eke mRudvIkAsamBavamityasya sthAne `madhunA saMBava'miti paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca | madhunA saMBavamiti madhukRutaSuktamucyate taduktaM ``jambIrANAM PalarasaM pippalImUlasaMyutam | madhuBANDe vinikShipya dhAnyarASau nidhApayet || tryaheNa tajjAtarasaM madhuSuktamudAhRutam'' iti | madhuBANDe madhupUrNaprAye BANDe ityarthaH | tadguNAH krameNa ``guDekShumadyamArdvIkaSuktaM laGu yathottaram'' || 10 ||
